_documentation.description: IAM Information for AWS Academy Lab Environment
_documentation.note: AWS Academy does NOT allow creating IAM roles/policies. We use the pre-existing LabRole for everything.
_documentation.important: The LabRole is automatically created by AWS Academy and has sufficient permissions for ECS, ECR, S3, CloudWatch, VPC, and ALB operations.

used_by: ECS Task Execution Role (pulls images from ECR, writes CloudWatch logs)
ECS Task Role (permissions available to the running container)
pre_attached_policies: Broad permissions for lab exercises (EC2, ECS, ECR, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, VPC, ELB, etc.)
Cannot access AWS Organizations or Billing

github_secrets_required.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: From AWS Academy Lab → AWS Details → AWS CLI credentials
github_secrets_required.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: From AWS Academy Lab → AWS Details → AWS CLI credentials
github_secrets_required.AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: From AWS Academy Lab → AWS Details → AWS CLI credentials (REQUIRED for Academy)

why_no_iam_creation.reason: AWS Academy restricts IAM operations. Students cannot create roles or policies.
why_no_iam_creation.solution: Use the pre-existing LabRole ARN that AWS Academy provides automatically.

important_academy_notes: Session tokens expire every ~4 hours — update GitHub Secrets when restarting lab
LabRole has broad permissions but CANNOT modify IAM
All resources are deleted when the lab session ends
Always use us-east-1 region unless specified otherwise
Budget limits apply — keep desired_count at 1
